text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is an interview day that includes a 
photoshoot in racewear.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I headed to the studio a bit early 
together with Satono Diamond. And now—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hm, hm, hmm~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having changed into her racewear, she 
moved and posed in front of the camera, 
constantly checking the monitor.
choice_data_list:
You're checking very thoroughly, aren't 
you?
You're doing a really thorough check, huh?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, because I want to make sure that what 
I want to show truly comes across.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. I incorporated the feelings I always 
hold dear as motifs into this racing 
outfit."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I truly want all the readers of the 
article to feel those things for 
themselves.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, there are some 
striking elements to her racing outfit.
choice_data_list: That diamond ornament really stands out

That diamond ornament really stands out, 
doesn't it?
Those ruffles leave quite an impression.
Those ruffles leave quite an impression.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, there are some 
striking elements to her racing outfit.
choice_data_list: That diamond ornament really stands out

That diamond ornament really stands out, 
doesn't it?
Those ruffles leave quite an impression.
Those ruffles leave quite an impression.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes, that is indeed the case!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It does incorporate my own name, but it 
also represents the firmness of my 
resolve.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
For instance, there are things called 
stalactites, correct?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Over tens, hundreds of thousands of years, 
by continuously falling in the exact same 
spot, it grows stronger and larger.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I believe an Umamusume's strength is quite 
similar to this as well.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—In other words, to pierce straight 
through with single-minded devotion.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Keep your eyes fixed on the goal and 
continue moving forward. I believe doing 
so will lead to victory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she spoke, a determination burned in 
her eyes just as strong as the conviction 
imbued within her diamond ornament.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh my, you noticed!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I do love ruffles in their own right 
because they're cute, but I also 
incorporated them to represent 
flexibility.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"The higher and further your destination, 
the more hardships stand in your path, 
don't they?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"If you take every single one of those 
head-on, even the hardest of gemstones 
will eventually crack."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That is why— Sometimes, one must gently 
deflect the blow.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
If we do that, unnecessary worries will 
diminish, and I believe we will be able to 
focus on the path we must take.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she spoke, a gentle light shone in her 
eyes just as soft as the conviction imbued 
within her frills.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We talked for a while after that, but 
there was still time before the 
photoshoot.
choice_data_list:
Shall we have something to drink while we 
wait?

Wanna grab something to drink while we 
wait?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Sounds lovely! Let us have tea time, then!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Um, where... might I be able to purchase 
some tea?
choice_data_list:
If I remember right, there was a vending 
machine in the hallway—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
A vending machine! When I caught a glimpse 
of it earlier, it looked a bit different 
from the usual ones, so it piqued my 
curiosity!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, leave this to me. I shall go 
purchase some tea from the vending 
machine!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I saw off the enthusiastic Satono Diamond, 
but... remembering her words, "She looked 
a bit different from usual," made me feel 
uneasy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I should keep watch by her side after all. 
Just as I thought that and moved to follow 
her―

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? I don't see any cans or plastic 
bottles. Should I press this panel? Or 
perhaps this button here?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Click, clack)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: My goodness! A cup came out!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Bzz-bz-bzzt!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, there is only ice in the cup?! Is 
the tea not coming out? Should I try to 
stop it?!
choice_data_list: I'm on my way, just wait right there!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"While nurturing her strong points, she 
still has areas to improve. I reaffirmed 
my commitment to watching over her 
properly going forward."
